column1: # lib.net.match batch: owner <TAB> kind <TAB> old <TAB> descriptor <TAB> semantic name
# Scope: com.noblemaster.lib.net.match (46 methods + 22 fields, 13 classes) - the match-making
# protocol, the record it exchanges and the codec that serialises it. Evidence per symbol:
# MatchRecord: the field order is pinned by MatchCodec.writeBody/readBody, and the meaning of each
#     - GameClient picks the connect target from the record: when the caller's own external address
#       equals g it dials e:f (same LAN), otherwise g:h (over the internet).
#   So: a=id, b=productId (the list/get filter string; GameServer passes GameConfig.getProductId()),
#   c=title (the lobby Label text), d=label (a "type|name" string the lobby splits to tell LAN from
#   internet games), e=localAddress, f=localPort, g=externalAddress, h=externalPort,
#   i=portOpen (UPnP mapping succeeded), j=timestamp (the match server refreshes it on every
#   update and drops records older than its expiry window).
#   Getters/setters take the same names (getId/setId ... isPortOpen/setPortOpen).
# MatchCodec / MatchListCodec: four symmetric entry points. read/write carry the nullable flag,
#   readBody/writeBody are the raw payload; the version int is already semantic (VERSION) and the
#   T04 batch added the "Unsupported match record version" check that readBody now performs.
# MatchMakingClient: fields a/b are the match-server host and port. The opcode written before each
#   request (0 create / 1 update / 2 get / 3 list) is how MatchRequestHandler dispatches, so the
#   methods are named after those ops: createMatch, updateMatch, getMatch, listMatches - each with
#   the public (instance) and private static (host, port, ...) form. The last private static
#   a(Socket, DataReader, DataWriter) is the shared close helper -> closeQuietly.
# AddressProvider / DefaultAddressProvider: a()/b() are the local (NetworkInterface, site-local)
#   and external (one of four "what is my IP" http services) address -> getLocalAddress /
#   getExternalAddress. The private a(String url) that reads one line from a URL -> fetchUrl.
# IpHelper: a(String) is true for 10/8, 192.168/16, 172.16/12 and 127.0.0.1 -> isPrivateAddress.
# PortMappingCallback: a(String, int) maps a game port through UPnP and returns the address to
# MatchMakingServer: a=expirySeconds, b=matches (the shared live list, also handed to every
#   MatchRequestHandler), c=queryBuffer (the second list is a reusable result buffer the handler
#   clears and fills for opcode 3, which is why it is shared with the handlers), d=serverSocket,
#   e=thread; a(port, backlog, expirySeconds) -> start, a() -> stop.
# MatchRequestHandler: a=socket, b=matches, c=queryBuffer (same three objects the server passes in).
# PortProbeServer: the synthetic outer reference a -> client, and b -> port (the UPnP probe port).
# Wire format note: nothing here is stored or looked up by member name - the protocol is a stream
# of opcodes and primitives, and the save file uses the same codec - so renaming cannot change the
# on-disk multiplayer.data or the network protocol.
